metadata.description: Every date range survives the conversion, whichever dash the author used, and remains findable by a pattern that allows all of them.
metadata.regression_of: 2026-09-25: pandoc writes an en dash as the two-character escape `--`, so a correction pattern built around a single-character dash class matched nothing in its output. It reported 4 files corrected out of 35 and looked plausible. The true number was 32. The 22 files it silently skipped would have kept a stale employment end date on resumes going to employers.
